title: Unpinned git dependency in pyproject.toml
description:
Line 27 of python/pyproject.toml specifies lora-medium without a commit hash, tag, or version constraint:

```
lora-medium @ git+https://github.com/MarkAtwood/lora-medium.git
```

**Impact:** Supply chain security risk. Any change to the upstream repo's default branch silently changes what gets installed. If the repo is compromised, all builds are affected. Reproducible builds are impossible.

**Fix:** Pin to a specific commit hash:
```
lora-medium @ git+https://github.com/MarkAtwood/lora-medium.git@<commit-sha>
```

Or use a tagged release if available.
